title: The infinite block spin Ising model
summary: We study a block mean-field Ising model with $N$ spins split into $s_N$ blocks, with Curie-Weiss interaction within blocks and nearest-neighbor coupling between blocks. While previous models deal with the block magnetization for a fixed number of blocks, we study the the simultaneous limit $N\to\infty$ and $s_N\to\infty$. The model interpolates between Curie-Weiss model for $s_N=1$, multi-species mean field for fixed $s_N=s$, and the 1D Ising model for each spin in its own block at $s_N=N$.
